title: Project P.I.T.T. Panel Rack — How to Unlock, Upgrade & Use It
description: Updated for 1.0.6: use the in-game unlock UI to check Panel Rack unlocks and upgrades; it now uses a dedicated key and won’t auto-dispense the next panel.
h1: Project P.I.T.T. Panel Rack — How to Unlock, Upgrade & Use It
quickAnswer: Check the current in-game unlock UI to unlock and upgrade the Panel Rack; Updated for 1.0.6 it now uses a dedicated Panel Rack key — after placing a panel it won’t auto-dispense, so press the Panel Rack key again for the next panel.

facts.label: Unlock
facts.value: Check the current in-game unlock UI for your save; exact unlock requirements are not reliably documented.

facts.label: Upgrades
facts.value: View Panel Rack upgrades in the in-game unlock UI; there is no confirmed Tier 3 or universal upgrade formula available.

facts.label: 1.0.6 use
facts.value: In 1.0.6 the Panel Rack has its own dedicated keybind and no longer automatically dispenses the next panel after placement.

facts.label: Next panel
facts.value: Press the dedicated Panel Rack key (current mapping) again to obtain the next panel; do not expect automatic continuous dispense.
